_comment: Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\fowl-autofix\config.json. Fowl Engine Manager's AUTO-FIX tab writes this file for you and passes the boxes (its SERVERS list) itself; fill `boxes` only to run autofix.py by hand. Claude Code uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if set, else the Claude account it is logged in to.
discord_webhook: <webhook URL of a private ops channel>
